blurb:
Experience Niagara Falls like never before on a full-day adventure from Toronto! Marvel at the falls by day, then be mesmerized by their glow at night. This tour includes complimentary pickup from convenient Toronto and airport pick up points by a professional tour guide who will guide you fully around Niagara Falls and historic sites. Take an unforgettable cruise up the falls for an extra splash of excitement, enjoy a Maple Syrup tasting, have dinner overlooking Niagara falls and watch a spectacular fireworks display! ( Weather dependent).

Please note: Minimum of 2 people per booking
